headline: Nancy — you don’t have a lead problem
subhead: The Nancy Kennedy Team already draws the hands. Valuations, DMs, and listing follow-through still depend on someone remembering. Here’s where it breaks — and what we’d build so it doesn’t.
observations: Nancy Kennedy — Licensed Associate Broker — The Nancy Kennedy Team at Houlihan Lawrence.
thenancykennedyteam.com already does the hard part: traffic, valuation, listings, local trust.
Pain: after someone fills Home Valuation or Contact, follow-up still depends on a person noticing.
Pain: Instagram / LinkedIn / Facebook DMs live outside CRM.
Blog, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook — usually separate chores. They should fire from one listing event.
Towns that matter here: Croton-on-Hudson, Cortlandt Manor, Yorktown, Ossining, White Plains.

opportunities.title: Valuations go quiet
opportunities.gap: Someone asks what their home is worth. Then… silence, or a late thank-you.
opportunities.fix: Same-day scored CRM lead + a reply that starts the listing talk.
opportunities.impact: You stop paying for traffic that dies in the inbox.

opportunities.title: DMs never become pipeline
opportunities.gap: Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook questions sit in the app. CRM never hears.
opportunities.fix: Every DM into one queue → draft → assign → log.
opportunities.impact: People who already reached out stop leaking to whoever answers first.

opportunities.title: Listing day is still a content scramble
opportunities.gap: Nancy goes live on MLS. Blog and social wait for “when someone has time.”
opportunities.fix: Listing event drafts the pack. Team approves once.
opportunities.impact: Marketing ships the same afternoon as the listing.

opportunities.title: Too many doors, no front desk
opportunities.gap: Forms, WhatsApp, Maps, portals — each with its own habit.
opportunities.fix: One front desk. AI drafts. Humans approve.
opportunities.impact: Nothing depends on who happened to check which app.

opportunities.title: AI search doesn’t know you
opportunities.gap: Buyers ask ChatGPT / Gemini “best realtor in Croton-on-Hudson.” Another name comes back.
opportunities.fix: Pages and proof those models can actually cite.
opportunities.impact: Your offline reputation shows up in the new default search.

openingMessage:
Hi Nancy —

The Nancy Kennedy Team doesn’t have a demand problem. People already find you on thenancykennedyteam.com.

The pain is quieter: valuation requests that cool off, DMs that never hit CRM, listing launches that wait for “someone to write the posts,” and a day spent stitching apps together.

We’re LimeDock. We build owned workflows for that — not another CRM. On a 30-minute call we learn how your team actually works, pick the first leak to close, and take it from there.

Could start with valuation follow-up. Or one inbox for forms + WhatsApp + social. Or listing → content pack. Local Mac/PC app if you want privacy, or Slack / Claude / ChatGPT if that’s where people live.

When someone asks AI for the best realtor in Croton-on-Hudson, we also care that your name is what comes back.

This page is a sketch. After the call: what we’d build, timeline, pricing.

— LimeDock
